posts.title: SQLite in the browser that reads pages on demand 🗄️
posts.ogTitle: SQLite in the browser that reads pages on demand
posts.excerpt: sql.js loads the full database file into memory, but ordinary SQLite reads one page at a time. This demo keeps that demand-paged model in the browser, with pages in IndexedDB, FTS5 and CRDT in one build, from a file:// page.

posts.title: Records that a group can keep, with no single keyholder as a target 🔐
posts.ogTitle: Cryptographic RBAC on a CRDT database — records that a group can keep, with no single keyholder as a target
posts.excerpt: localRbac enforces role-based access control with cryptography only, in a local-first CRDT database that a group edits offline and merges. Shamir secret sharing splits the master key k-of-n, and thus no single keyholder is a target for coercion.

posts.title: One HTML file compared with a web application: sample intake without the long IT approval process 📄
posts.ogTitle: One HTML file compared with a web application: sample intake without the long IT approval process
posts.excerpt: A web application is easy to build, but IT approval for a server, a login, and a database is difficult. One offline HTML file with SQLite and Web Crypto is a free intermediate step, and its QR code removes transcription.

posts.title: RheoServ Waumpaum — a credit-union core in one HTML file 🏦
posts.ogTitle: RheoServ Waumpaum — a credit-union core in one HTML file
posts.excerpt: RheoServ Waumpaum is a credit-union core banking system in one encrypted HTML file. A CRDT merges the offline changes of the operators, and institutions settle with waumpaums.

posts.title: Hide a plastron link in an image with ChaosEdgeSteg 🐢
posts.ogTitle: Hide a plastron link in an image with ChaosEdgeSteg
posts.excerpt: A plastron sheetapp hides a plastron.ca share link in a PNG that you can post to X. The upstream ChaosEdgeSteg Python code runs without changes in Pyodide.

posts.title: An offline HRIS for a community police office 👮
posts.ogTitle: An offline HRIS for a community police office
posts.excerpt: A proof of concept puts CRDT SQLite in one HTML file to merge HR data offline. The demo shows a fictional Juárez police office, and the plan is to use the same patterns in plastron.
